workflows.description: controlled physics derivation autoformalization over Isabelle/HOL using shared physics preformalization and Isabelle-specific grounding, drafting, execution, final review, and consistency gates without modifying the Lean physics loop.

epistemic_contract.assurance_justification: Each occurrence preserves its own generated or computed provenance; the final wrapper follows the final occurrence.
epistemic_contract.defeater_rationale: Evidence labels remain capped until native adapters and independent behavioral oracles execute.
defeaters: A structural or fake-handler run does not establish native execution, mathematical correctness, or semantic equivalence.
observations: The canonical hook registry fixes hook order, owner skills, declared outputs, and gate text.
epistemic_contract.output_meaning: The final domain-specific artifact produced by the layered isabelle_physics_derivation_trace_loop shell.
epistemic_contract.question: What typed artifacts and dispositions result from the declared isabelle_physics_derivation_trace_loop contract?
epistemic_contract.subject: The exact source artifacts and gates traversed by isabelle_physics_derivation_trace_loop.

reasoning_projection.description: Expand and review a source derivation, prepare its Isabelle formalization packet and physical model, build the theory, review it, and report status.
reasoning_projection.name: ReconstructInIsabelle

occurrences.rationale: Recover source-anchored physical meaning and applicability scope.
Review expansion completeness and bindings, expose anchored translation lines, reuse decisions, missing premises, and gap obligations.
Model quantities, dimensions, units, frames, regimes, and laws.
Align obligations and physical concepts with applicable Isabelle/HOL material.
Draft an Isabelle theory while retaining open obligations.
Record session-build evidence and artifact-realness findings.
Assess formal hypotheses and obligation coverage.
Assess preservation of the intended physical meaning.
Record process lessons without changing the artifact's authority.
Aggregate session, realness, hypothesis, source, and process findings into an Isabelle physics disposition.

reasoning_projection.projection_scope: one source-to-session Isabelle/HOL physics formalization and review episode
